darasa.metaDescription: Join your Nuru class with your teacher's code, your name and your secret pictures.

jiunge.title: Join a class
jiunge.lead: Your teacher has a class code. Type it here.
jiunge.kamaLogtoMaelezo: You are signed in with your account, so you skip the secret pictures.

jina.title: Who are you?
jina.mpyaLead: Use the name your teacher and classmates know you by.
jina.label: Your name
jina.hakunaBado: Nobody has joined yet. Be the first.

picha.chaguaLead: Tap three pictures, one after another. Remember the order: it is your key.
picha.thibitishaLead: The same three pictures, in the same order.
picha.wekaUpyaLead: Your teacher cleared your old pictures. Pick 3 new ones and remember them.
picha.hazilingani: The pictures do not match. Choose again.

makosa.msimbo_si_sahihi: A code has 6 characters, like KJM-7Q4.
makosa.darasa_halipo: No class has this code. Ask your teacher again.
makosa.jina_si_sahihi: Use 2 to 40 characters for your name.
makosa.jina_limechukuliwa: Someone in the class already has this name. Add your family initial, e.g. Amina J.
makosa.mwanafunzi_hayupo: This name is no longer in the class. Ask your teacher.
makosa.imefungwa: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
makosa.imefungwa_mwalimu: Too many wrong tries. Ask your teacher to reset your pictures.

nyumbani.tokaMaelezo: Sharing a phone? Tap Sign out when you finish so a classmate can sign in.
nyumbani.tokaMtandao: You are still signed in: no connection. Reconnect, then tap Sign out again.
nyumbani.tokaFoleni: You are still signed in: your attempts have not reached your teacher yet. Wait for the connection, then tap Sign out again.
nyumbani.hongera: Haba na haba hujaza kibaba: little by little fills the measure.
nyumbani.hakuna: Your teacher has not assigned lessons yet.
